fact: In the two pilot municipalities of Manga and Bingo, KIX-SEEDS has moved school data from paper to a digital system: more than 12,000 pupils are tracked individually by a unique identifier, with teachers entering marks on an Android app and school heads seeing attendance in real time; extension to other regions and to the national SIGE is planned.
title: Actualités KIX-SEEDS Burkina Faso
publisher: KIX-SEEDS Burkina Faso (ISSP / Université Joseph KI-ZERBO)
